title: Pyne Pod Cola Lime Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pyne Pod NicSalts Cola Lime 10ml E-Liquid offers a complex and highly refreshing twist on a classic soda flavour. The inhale delivers the familiar, syrupy sweetness and subtle spice of traditional Cola, providing a rich and comforting base. To elevate the beverage profile, a sharp, zesty note of fresh Lime cuts through the sweetness on the exhale, leaving the palate feeling thoroughly refreshed and cleansed. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Pyne Pod Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Pyne Pod Nic Salts collection translates the intense, highly popular flavours of their renowned prefilled pods into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the crisp soda notes of Cola Lime, vapers can explore other irresistible blends such as the exotic Fruit Punch, the intense citrus of Lemon Lime, or the layered sweetness of Sakura Grape.
